concept: Route 53: latency-based routing with health checks
tests: How to route users to the nearest healthy region with automatic failover.
expected: Latency-based routing + health checks: users go to the lowest-latency region, unhealthy endpoints are excluded. Triggers: "nearest healthy regional endpoint", "failing over automatically".
why_not: A simple/static record cannot route by latency and does not fail over; weighted distributes by weights, not proximity.
